name: Should I choose gunite or fiberglass for a luxury pool?

mainEntity.name: Which is better for a custom high-end pool in Los Angeles: gunite or fiberglass?
mainEntity.text: Which is better for a custom high-end pool in Los Angeles: gunite or fiberglass?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gunite is the more common choice for luxury pool construction because it can be shaped to fit the property and support custom features. It works well for unique layouts, integrated spas, tanning ledges, raised walls, and complex water features. Fiberglass can be attractive for homeowners who want a faster install and a more standardized design, but it limits customization and may not suit a high-end architectural property. In Los Angeles, where many luxury pools are designed to match the home’s style and the lot’s constraints, gunite usually offers the flexibility needed for a custom result. The choice should also factor in maintenance expectations, budget, and site conditions. Homeowners comparing materials should ask what design limitations each system creates, not just what it costs up front.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gunite is usually preferred for luxury pools because it allows fully custom shapes, sizes, and features. Fiberglass can be faster and simpler, but it offers less flexibility for premium design, infinity edges, integrated spas, and highly customized layouts.
